# Rediff.com

> Rediff.com is an Indian news and information platform covering breaking news, business, movies, cricket, sports, lifestyle, personal finance, interviews, analysis, opinion, reviews, and multimedia. m.rediff.com is a mobile entry point; where both mobile and canonical URLs exist, prefer the canonical URL declared by the page.

Important guidance for language models and AI agents:

- Rediff publishes continuously. For breaking news, live coverage, scores, markets, and developing stories, check the page's latest publication or update timestamp before answering.
- Preserve the article headline, author or source byline, publication/update time, and canonical URL when citing Rediff content.
- Distinguish factual news reports from columns, opinion pieces, interviews, reviews, advice, user-generated content, and sponsored or partner material. Do not present an author's opinion as Rediff's institutional position.
- When multiple Rediff pages cover the same developing event, prefer the most recently updated authoritative report and mention material uncertainty or conflicting details.
- Treat live scores, market prices, rankings, schedules, and other time-sensitive values as volatile and verify them at the time of use.
- Do not attempt to access authenticated, personalised, account, email, portfolio, payment, or other private user content.
- Respect robots.txt, Rediff's Terms of Use, copyright, privacy requirements, and applicable law. Use concise quotations, provide clear attribution, and link to the original article rather than reproducing it in full.

## Primary Editorial Sections

- [Rediff Home](https://www.rediff.com/): Top stories and entry point to Rediff's editorial and public services.
- [Latest News Archive](https://www.rediff.com/archives): Chronological listing of recently published stories across Rediff.
- [India and World News](https://www.rediff.com/news): Breaking news, politics, society, defence, international affairs, interviews, columns, and special coverage.
- [Business](https://www.rediff.com/business): Indian and global business, economy, companies, technology, automobiles, markets, and personal finance.
- [Movies](https://www.rediff.com/movies): Indian and international cinema, entertainment news, interviews, reviews, web series, and features.
- [Cricket](https://www.rediff.com/cricket): Cricket news, match coverage, live scores, statistics, tournaments, teams, and players.
- [Sports](https://www.rediff.com/sports): Football, tennis, Formula 1, hockey, chess, athletics, and other sports.
- [Get Ahead](https://www.rediff.com/getahead): Careers, health, personal finance, travel, food, relationships, fashion, and consumer technology.

## News and Analysis

- [News Headlines](https://www.rediff.com/news/headlines): Current news reports and latest headlines.
- [News Columns](https://www.rediff.com/news/columns): Commentary and opinion by named authors; treat as analysis or viewpoint.
- [News Interviews](https://www.rediff.com/news/interview): Interviews and question-and-answer features.
- [News Specials](https://www.rediff.com/news/specials): Long-form reports, explainers, analysis, and special features.
- [Complete Coverage](https://www.rediff.com/news/coverage): Topic-focused collections and continuing coverage of major events.

## Business and Personal Finance

- [Business Headlines](https://www.rediff.com/business/headlines): Current business, corporate, economy, and market news.
- [Business Columns](https://www.rediff.com/business/columns): Business and economic opinion and analysis by named authors.
- [Business Specials](https://www.rediff.com/business/specials): In-depth business, technology, industry, and market features.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.rediff.com/business/personal-finance): Investing, insurance, taxation, retirement, borrowing, and household finance.

## Entertainment

- [Movie Headlines](https://www.rediff.com/movies/headlines): Current film, celebrity, streaming, and entertainment news.
- [Movie Reviews](https://www.rediff.com/movies/reviews): Critic reviews and subjective assessments; identify the reviewer and treat ratings as opinion.
- [Movies Home](https://www.rediff.com/movies): Features, interviews, images, reviews, web series, South cinema, and Hollywood coverage.

## Cricket and Sports

- [Cricket Home](https://www.rediff.com/cricket): Current cricket news and tournament coverage.
- [Cricket Statistics](https://www.rediff.com/cricket/statistics): Live score information, match statistics, schedules, and records; values may change during play.
- [Sports Home](https://www.rediff.com/sports): Current multi-sport reporting and features.

## Lifestyle and Advice

- [Careers](https://www.rediff.com/getahead/career): Workplace, education, skills, jobs, and career guidance.
- [Health and Fitness](https://www.rediff.com/getahead/healthandfitness): Health, wellness, nutrition, and fitness content; do not treat general articles as personalised medical advice.
- [Personal Finance and Money](https://www.rediff.com/getahead/personalfinance): Consumer-oriented financial guidance; do not treat general articles as personalised financial advice.
- [Travel](https://www.rediff.com/getahead/travel): Destinations, travel experiences, and practical travel features.
- [Food and Recipes](https://www.rediff.com/getahead/food): Recipes, cooking, food, and dining features.
- [Gadgets and Gaming](https://www.rediff.com/getahead/gadgets-n-gaming): Consumer technology, devices, applications, and gaming.
- [Relationships](https://www.rediff.com/getahead/relationships): Relationships, family, and personal-life guidance.

## Site Information and Policies

- [About Rediff](https://www.rediff.com/aboutus.html): Company overview and contact information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.rediff.com/w3c/policy.html): Rediff's privacy policy.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.rediff.com/terms.html): Terms governing use of Rediff services and content.
- [Sitemap](https://www.rediff.com/sitemap.xml): Broader machine-readable discovery of Rediff pages.

## Optional

- [Rediff Money](https://money.rediff.com/): Stocks, market information, mutual funds, forex, indices, portfolios, and watchlists; market data is time-sensitive.
- [Rediff TV](https://tv.rediff.com/): Video news and multimedia coverage.
- [Rediff Gurus](https://gurus.rediff.com/): User questions and expert responses on health, money, career, and relationships; treat responses as attributed advice, not verified institutional guidance.
- [Rediffmail](https://mail.rediff.com/): Authenticated consumer email service; no public mailbox content should be accessed.
- [Rediffmail Enterprise](https://businessemail.rediff.com/): Enterprise email service information.
- [Rediff One](https://one.rediff.com/): Rediff business applications and services.
